case_number: 2025 INSC 425; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. [ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NOS.7930-7931 OF 2020]
summary: Eligibility of Syrang-licensed candidate for Lascar post; higher qualification not disqualification per Parvaiz Ahmed Parry precedent; tribunal proceedings defect due to non-joinder of appellant as party; KPSC letter (2012) treating Syrang licence as sufficient examined; finality of ranked list vs statutory requirement of Lascar licence; constitutional power under Article 142 considered.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; tribunal order and high court judgment set aside; appointment of appellant as Boat Lascar restored.
